newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day Cetes rate falls on auction result.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day Cetes rate falls on auction result.

text.p: Mexico's same-day Cetes rates opened slightly weaker, falling 20 basis points to 22.90 percent, after rates adjusted to the results of the primary Cetes auction, dealers said.
"The market was expecting these levels, but some hoped for higher rates and that put some pressure on yields," said one dealer.
On Tuesday, Banco de Mexico said that the bellwether one-month paper rate rose five basis piints to 24.38 percent. The one-year paper was the only term that showed a small decline in rates.
Bank notes and acceptances, including pagares, were unchanged at 24.75 percent.
Maturing credits are seen at 4.0 billion pesos, but dealers are not ruling out a large injection by banco de Mexico because of month-end pressures.
